claims.text: A fine-tuned LLaMA-8B filter estimates whether each retrieved QA pair answers one of the identified missing slots.
The method combines semantic-retrieval and slot-filling scores using a weighted sum, then selects QA pairs by the combined score.
The filter's slot-utility scores are available before the method combines them with semantic scores to rank QA pairs.
